apps.localizedDescription:
Save and download videos, photos, and music from 16 platforms. No watermarks. No accounts. No tracking. Everything stays on your device.

📋 Table of Contents:

• How to Use.

• Mori CLI (Terminal).

• Supported Platforms & Scraper Engines.
• For Developers & Building from Source.
• Scraper Architecture.

Saving media with Mori takes only three simple steps:

• Copy Link: Copy any video, photo, or music link from your favorite app (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Spotify, etc.).

📥 Download & Installation:

📖 Need help installing or troubleshooting? Read the complete Installation, Sideloading & User Guide (GUIDE.md).

💡 Why Desktop GUI Deleted? Desktop GUI builds (.dmg, .exe, .msi) previously built with Tauri have been retired and consolidated into the standalone Mori CLI (@coflyn/mori).

versions.localizedDescription:
New Features & Enhancements:

• Silent Shorts Normalization: Automatic canonicalization in batch analyzer (analyzeUrlSilent) ensuring queued YouTube Shorts links resolve reliably without manual URL editing.

Bug Fixes & Scraper Repairs:

• Instagram FastDL Backend: Migrated backend to FastDL with automated token and expiry extraction (k_exp, k_token), direct embed fallback (/embed/captioned/), and InDown token caching.
• Spotify Track & Cookie Persistence: Fixed session cookie loss across Spotimate endpoints, replaced fragile regex matching with DOMParser, and enabled instant direct MP3 link extraction.
• Bilibili Shortlinks & Anime OGV: Added shortlink redirect resolver for b23.tv / bili.im, supported international bilibili.tv aid and OGV anime play/episode endpoints with OpenGraph fallback.

• Pixiv Login-Wall Bypass: Added meta-preload-data fallback for age-restricted/login-walled posts, Ugoira MP4 conversion, and pixiv.re reverse-proxy thumbnail support.
• Threads Extraction Fix: Fixed empty Cookie: "" header wiping request cookies during media extraction, added guarded shortlink redirect resolver, and expanded media selectors.

• Pixiv Thumbnail Preview Header: Added Pixiv referer header in preview generator to eliminate 403 Forbidden errors when loading artwork thumbnails.

Performance & Reliability:

• Desktop Tauri Retirement: Retired legacy desktop GUI builds (.dmg, .exe, .msi) and removed all residual src-tauri/ Rust backend files and build dependencies.
